filterSummary: Successfully selected 10 videos, one for each of the 5 topics in both English and Arabic. The selected videos are highly relevant, from reputable educational channels, and have strong viewership, indicating peer approval. In cases with many strong candidates, view count was used as a decisive factor for quality and student preference.
